name: mod-affixes
about: Issue #17, mods/affixes: Rare and Epic items may roll a second suffix (the rare tier) and Epic items a second prefix (the epic tier), affixes.chance (25) percent each. Rolls 400 Epic and 400 Rare items through the generator (rates, no duplicate mod, no tier over two, one skill), 100% and off, gives an Epic chest piece with both extras (tooltip shot), saves, restarts and finds it unchanged.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:affixes\] roll: 400 epic at ilvl 30 \(chance 25%\): second suffix (?:6\d|7\d|8\d|9\d|1[0-3]\d|140), second prefix (?:6\d|7\d|8\d|9\d|1[0-3]\d|140), max mods 5, over two 0, duplicates 0, two skills 0
steps.name: 400 Epic: about a quarter get a second suffix, a quarter a second prefix; none doubled, no tier over two, one skill at most

steps.pattern: \[HWP:affixes\] roll: 400 rare at ilvl 30 \(chance 25%\): second suffix (?:6\d|7\d|8\d|9\d|1[0-3]\d|140), second prefix 0, max mods 3, over two 0, duplicates 0, two skills 0
steps.name: 400 Rare: about a quarter get a second suffix, never a prefix

steps.pattern: \[HWP:affixes\] roll: (\d+) epic at ilvl 1 \(chance 100%\): second suffix \1, second prefix \1, max mods 5, over two 0, duplicates 0, two skills 0
steps.name: at 100% every Epic gets both, even at item level 1

steps.pattern: \[HWP:affixes\] roll: 200 epic at ilvl 30 \(chance off\): second suffix 0, second prefix 0, max mods 3, over two 0, duplicates 0, two skills 0
steps.name: off: vanilla items
give: an Epic chest piece with both extras
after save and restart the item keeps its two suffixes and two prefixes

steps.pattern: \[HWP:affixes\] bag: 1 item\(s\) with an extra affix
steps.name: one item with extras in the bag
